references.text: The same introductory formula 'And the Lord spoke to Moses and said' is used consistently in the Books of Moses to introduce divine commands
The same introductory formula at the beginning of Leviticus, where the Lord speaks to Moses
The opening formula in Numbers where the Lord speaks to Moses, with the same structure as here
A similar introduction where the Lord gives Moses instructions regarding the camp of Israel
Close context in the same chapter where the Lord also speaks to Moses about the service of the Levites
Same chapter, repeated formula when the Lord continues to give instructions concerning the counting of the Levites
